subject.title: [Bug] Feishu plugin 2026.5.22: gateway connection timeout + QR code display broken

question: Should the remaining Feishu startup timeout be resolved by accepting the ambient-proxy HTTP repair in #86386, by changing startup preflight timing/readiness behavior, or by waiting for fresh live Windows Feishu proof first?
rationale: The QR half is now fixed on current main, but the remaining startup symptom sits on credentialed Feishu HTTP/proxy and startup-readiness behavior where AGENTS.md treats setup, startup, provider routing, and fallback changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Review #86386 As The Primary Startup Fix
options.body: Treat the open proxy-aware Feishu HTTP PR as the current best candidate, accept or reject its proxy/security tradeoff, and keep this issue linked until that decision lands.

options.title: Request Fresh Live Feishu Startup Proof
options.body: Ask for current Windows Feishu CN gateway logs or Crabbox-style proof before changing startup/proxy behavior beyond the QR fix.

options.title: Split Startup Policy From This Issue
options.body: Keep this issue focused on user symptoms but move the proxy/default/startup-readiness decision into a narrower maintainer-owned follow-up.

recommendation.title: Review #86386 As The Primary Startup Fix
recommendation.body: Treat the open proxy-aware Feishu HTTP PR as the current best candidate, accept or reject its proxy/security tradeoff, and keep this issue linked until that decision lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names @m1heng as the community maintainer contact, making them the best available owner for the plugin-level startup/proxy decision.
